title: Bounded-below coherent direct image with proper supports on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]; quasi-compact means every open cover has a finite subcover and quasi-separated means the diagonal is quasi-compact. Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $Y$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $f:X\to Y$ be its structure morphism. Assume $f$ is locally of finite type on etale scheme charts [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use module sheaves on the small etale ringed sites [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Coherent means quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and, on Noetherian affine etale charts $\operatorname{Spec}R$, associated to a finitely generated $R$-module, whose associated sheaf has value $B\otimes_R M$ on affine etale charts $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $G\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology, zero in all sufficiently negative degrees. For every integer $q$, assume its support $\operatorname{Supp}_X\mathcal H^q(G)$ [def-sfb-space-module-support] is a closed subset whose reduced induced closed subspace is proper over $Y$. Here a reduced induced closed subspace is the closed subspace with that point set and reduced etale charts, and proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. Write $Rf_*$ for the total right derived functor [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of canonical module direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], computed with K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Then $Rf_*G$ has coherent cohomology and its cohomology vanishes in all sufficiently negative degrees. No properness, separatedness or quasi-compactness of $f$, and no upper bound on $G$, is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), with the auxiliary base scheme S=Y; unlike the proper-morphism specialization, supports alone are proper.

proof.text: Work on the small site skeletons prescribed by [def-weil-size-convention]. Their structure sheaves are commutative ring sheaves, so [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian] makes both categories of module sheaves Grothendieck abelian. The smallness hypothesis is satisfied in the enlarged universe in which the module and derived categories are formed; no smallness or quasi-compactness of the underlying space is being inferred.

source.place: Section 07A5 (section-unbounded), first paragraph: module sheaves on a ringed site are Grothendieck abelian

proof.text: The canonical module functor $f_*$ is additive and left exact directly from [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Indeed its sections at $V$ are compatible families of chart sections; addition and the induced maps are componentwise. By the sectionwise kernel formula of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a family is killed by $f_*u$ exactly when every chart component lies in $\ker u$. These are precisely the compatible families defining $f_*(\ker u)$. The terminal zero family is preserved as well. Thus the kernel and zero-object tests for left exactness hold. On bounded below inputs, the functor $Rf_*$ of [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] is the same right derived functor used in the two abstract lemmas below: choose the same K-injective resolution on either side and both give its degreewise direct image.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), setup of the truncation proof; canonical module direct image and K-injective convention

proof.text: Choose $b\in\mathbf Z$ such that $\mathcal H^j(G)=0$ for $j<b$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing] to $v=f_*$, the module categories verified above, and this lower bound. It gives $\mathcal H^j(Rf_*G)=0$ for every $j<b$. This bound is fixed once for $G$ and does not depend on a truncation degree.

source.place: Tag 05TC (lemma-negative-vanishing), part (1), used in the Tag 0D0R truncation argument

proof.text: Fix any integer $n\ge b$ and put $G_n=\tau_{\le n}G$ using [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Its cohomology is $\mathcal H^q(G)$ for $q\le n$ and zero for $q>n$; hence it is zero outside $[b,n]$. The nonzero cohomology sheaves have the original coherent modules and proper supports. The zero sheaves are coherent and have empty support, whose reduced closed subspace is empty and proper over $Y$. Thus [lem-sfb-space-proper-support-bounded-coherent-image] applies with auxiliary scheme $S=Y$ and $E=G_n$: the morphism is locally of finite type, the target is Noetherian, and every cohomology support is proper over the target. It follows that $Rf_*G_n$ has coherent cohomology. This application requires no quasi-compactness, separatedness or properness of $f$.

source.place: Tag 0D0R (lemma-direct-image-coherent-bdd-below), second proof: apply Tag 08GK (lemma-direct-image-coherent) to a bounded truncation

proof.text: For the canonical map $c_n:G_n\to G$, apply the final clause of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-truncation-iso] with $v=f_*$. Both inputs are bounded below by $b$; more explicitly $\mathcal H^i(c_n)$ is an isomorphism for $i\le n$ and its map in degree $n+1$ is $0\to\mathcal H^{n+1}(G)$, a monomorphism. The lemma therefore gives $\mathcal H^n(Rf_*G_n)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H^n(Rf_*G)$. Coherence is unchanged under an isomorphism, since on each affine etale chart it is the property of being associated to a finite module. Step 4 proves coherence of the left side, so the right side is coherent. This handles every $n\ge b$; all degrees below $b$ are zero by step 3 and hence coherent. Together with that fixed lower bound, this proves the assertion.

lean.statement: theorem properSupport_below_coherent_image (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (X : AlgebraicSpace Y) (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))) (hf : MapIsLocally (@LocallyOfFiniteType) f) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.SmallModules] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))).SmallModules] (G : X.DerivedModules) (hcoh : ∀ q : ℤ, (X.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules q).obj G)).IsFinitePresentation) (hbelow : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < b → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules q).obj G)) (hsupport : ∀ q : ℤ, IsClosed (moduleSupport (X.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules q).obj G))) ∧ ∃ (Z : AlgebraicSpace Y) (i : Z ⟶ X), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsClosedImmersion p.left) i.hom.hom ∧ (∀ T : Z.EtaleSite, IsReduced (Z.etaleForget.obj T)) ∧ Set.range (mapPoint i.hom.hom) = moduleSupport (X.smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules q).obj G)) ∧ MapIsProper (i ≫ f)) : (∀ q : ℤ, ((schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))).smallModuleEquivalence.inverse.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))).SmallModules q).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj G))).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < b → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (schemeSpace (Over.mk (𝟙 Y))).SmallModules q).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj G))
